verdict.explanation: The signed receipt claims all 3 named hardeners are uncheckable by the AV<->AHEW relationship because 'no amine value reported'. But the amine value for all 3 is published in the EXACT document already cited as the load-bearing `url` for each hardener's own AHEW fact in facts.json (the Evonik AMERICAS curing agents product guide) -- the oracle never read past the pre-existing amine_value.* keys in facts.json to check the cited source documents themselves. All 3 are in fact checkable, and (bonus finding) all 3 pass the admissibility band once checked -- but the SIGNED claim 'n_uncheckable_no_amine_value=3 / remain single-source' is false as written: it describes an evaluability gap that does not exist in the cited sources.
